document_kind: run-spec template (Strategy E v1; instantiate to /results/<family_id>/rounds/<round_id>/attempts/<run_id>/run-spec.json BEFORE launch)

template_instantiation.rule: Domains, split, cycle plan, costs, gates and the selector/disposition versions are FROZEN before the first run and must be copied from the instantiated round-spec.json. Only the seven placeholders may be substituted. {{script_sha256}} must be the host-side recomputed sha256 of the deployed /scripts/50_strategy_e_run.py (contract 16.2 P10 recomputes it); the run fails closed if the deployed script does not match.

data.bar_labelling: VERIFIED open_time_ms = bar START (UTC); contiguous 3,600,000 ms grid, close_time_ms = open_time_ms + 3,599,999 ms; measured on all four registered symbols over the registered window before this pre-registration was instantiated, and both legs of every registered pair were confirmed to share the same contiguous 1h grid (the engine fails closed on any misalignment)

funding_series_contract.engine_rule: The position is exposed to every funding settlement whose raw instant lies in the CLOSED interval [entry instant - 1s, exit instant + 1s]; each settlement is charged at its own instant on that leg's position notional at the close mark of the bar containing it (or the exit notional at the closing boundary). The sign follows the leg: a positive rate is a cost to a long leg and a credit to a short leg. The measured raw jitter is 0..28 ms LATE and never early.
funding_series_contract.pair_alignment_rule: Each leg carries its own funding series and its own settlement instants (modelled 2022 segment and SOLUSDT's early-2022 2h/4h-era schedule included); the engine never assumes a fixed 8h grid and never substitutes one leg's schedule for the other's.

parameter_domain.copula_selection_status: RESEARCH_PROPOSED (registered before the first run) - AIC selection over the five families with a Rosenblatt-transform GOF gate; the five forced-family substitution cases run at the registered reference cell and never replace the primary AIC reading.
parameter_domain.entry_timing_status: RESEARCH_PROPOSED - a bar-close CMI signal fills at the NEXT bar's open (the source assumes same-bar execution; this round registers the no-look-ahead convention instead).

cycle_domain.cycle_anchoring: Cycle boundaries are anchored on the registered data start, so every slice evaluates a subset of the same cycles; a slice evaluates exactly the cycles whose whole trading window lies inside it, and a formation window may reach back into the historical period for an OOS cycle (walk-forward, no future information).
cycle_domain.hedge_ratio_rule: OLS slope of log P1 on log P2 over the formation window; leg 2 notional = |beta| x leg 1 notional at entry and at every scale-in.
cycle_domain.marginal_rule: Frozen formation empirical CDF: u = #{formation values <= x} / n; a trading price outside the formation range saturates at 0 or 1 (counted per cycle).
cycle_domain.max_holding_note: The registered 336-bar holding bound is an OUTER bound: with a 336-bar trading window and a next-bar entry the cycle-end flatten binds first. The engine still evaluates and reports max_holding_exits separately (0 by construction), so the bound is visible in the artifacts instead of implied.
cycle_domain.criteria_status: RESEARCH_PROPOSED - the source specifies the tests and screens but not their critical values, lags, hedge-ratio band or bootstrap size; every number is registered in the round-spec and applied identically to all six cohorts.
cycle_domain.cointegration_rule: Engle-Granger (ADF, constant, 24 lags) AND Kapetanios-Shin-Snell must both reject the unit root, and the residual half-life must be below 30 days; otherwise the cycle is not tradable and holds no position.

dca_domain.base_quote_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_CONSTANT - held constant across the whole domain (it is NOT a search axis) and NOT a user-fixed invariant: no operator evidence fixes it at 1000. It is a project pre-registration choice, frozen here before any computation (contract 7.2 v1.3.1).
dca_domain.spacing_pct_status: PROJECT_PRE_REGISTERED_SEARCH_DOMAIN - this axis IS searched over the registered values. The axis is a pre-registered search DOMAIN of this round, not an immutable user-fixed invariant (contract 7.2 v1.3.1).

provenance_mirror.entry_timing_status: RESEARCH_PROPOSED - the source assumes same-bar execution; this round registers NEXT-BAR-OPEN execution (a bar-close signal fills at the following bar's open), which is the contract's no-look-ahead rule and is disclosed as a deliberate deviation from the source's assumption.
provenance_mirror.copula_selection_status: RESEARCH_PROPOSED (registered before the first run) - the source specifies AIC selection over the five families and a Rosenblatt-transform GOF (KS and CvM, bootstrap p-value >= 5%); this round additionally registers the five forced-family substitution cells at the reference cell so the family substitution the source lists as a falsification item is measured, not assumed. The substitution never replaces the primary AIC selection: it is a separate registered case and is reported on its own.

costs.source: canonical instrument metadata, read at run time from /data/raw
costs.source_cost_track: REGISTERED: the source_cost_0p12pct grid charges 0.0003 (3 bps) per fill per leg, which reproduces the source's declared 0.12% two-leg round trip (4 fills x 3 bps); it is deliberately cheaper than the canonical 5 bps taker fee and exists only to re-measure the same cells under the source's own cost assumption
costs.funding: charged per settlement inside each leg's closed holding interval; funding_2x doubles it and the no_funding grids zero it (descriptive)
costs.funding_exposure_rule: The position is exposed to every funding settlement whose raw instant lies in the CLOSED interval [entry instant - 1s, exit instant + 1s]. The measured raw jitter of the settlement timestamps is 0..28 ms LATE and never early, so a settlement sitting on a bar boundary is charged to the episode that holds the position at that instant, and every settlement is charged on its own leg's series and instant (never a fixed 8h assumption).

expected.arithmetic: 6 pair cohorts (the six pairs of BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/BNBUSDT/SOLUSDT at 1h) x 20 registered strategy cases x 48 DCA configs = 960 base combinations per phase grid; x 11 phase grids = 63,360 full case evaluations. A case evaluation = one engine simulation of one joint parameter cell of one pair cohort on one phase grid.

runtime_expectation.basis: Strategy A v2 measured 103,680 case evaluations in 1,302 s in qlib-run; Strategy C measured 1,584 cases in 29 s. This family evaluates 63,360 cells whose episodes hold only inside the registered 336-bar trading windows, plus a per-cycle copula fit with a B=100 parametric-bootstrap GOF per qualifying cycle (6 cohorts x up to 116 cycles).
runtime_expectation.estimate: a detached run of roughly one hour (1h bin rebuild for four symbols + cycle precompute + 63,360 cell simulations); an estimate from the card's synthetic benchmark, not a guarantee. Progress is read from artifacts/progress.json, the per-pair log lines and state.json.
runtime_expectation.status: estimate only; the run is launched detached inside the container and monitored from the attempt state/log, never by holding an agent turn open

script.deployed_from: HCH725/quant-runtime-pipeline container/scripts/50_strategy_e_run.py (byte-identical, P10 recomputes it host side)

falsification: no signal / insufficient trades (G2: fewer than 60 historical pair-cycles in the cohort's best case, or fewer than 20 in the winner's OOS slice)
source-consistency: reproducing the source's negative net-return conclusion is recorded as REJECT, never as PASS (family-level, never PASS)
cost-boundary: the canonical and source-reported cost tracks disagree in sign on an elected winner (family-level, never PASS)
pair-concentration: the OOS positive contribution concentrates in one pair above 70% (family-level disclosure, never PASS)
grid-instability: an elected winner's t_o/t_c neighbourhood disagrees in OOS sign on 40% or more of its neighbours (family-level disclosure, never PASS)
coverage incomplete in any registered phase grid (G1)
the source-cost track is a no-op (TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE)
notes: One attempt of round {{round_id}}. The engine rebuilds the qlib .bin store from the read-only raw store, fits one copula per 2160h formation window with a B=100 bootstrap GOF gate, evaluates 6 pair cohorts x 20 strategy cases x 48 DCA configs on 11 registered phase grids, and writes the registered artifacts. The runner's verdict_recommendation is a recommendation; the final verdict.json is written by the Hermes default card after reading the artifacts back (contract 10.7).
